comment: Divergence ledger — read by the unified corpus gate (corpus_gate); BOTH
channels gate commits. Replaces the report-only known_diffs.json. Entries
mask NOTHING silently: each pins WHERE and HOW MUCH a case may diverge on a
channel and FAILS the gate when stale (a divergence that no longer exceeds
the tier floor, or an entry whose scope never matched). Envelopes are per-
case, per-channel, per-scope MEASURED facts with a mandatory cause+source —
NEVER a tolerance (tier floors in tests/harness are untouched and structurally
unreachable from here). Every add/widen/flip lands as a population-lock diff.
Kinds: 'divergence' (field-granular envelope, re-asserted within its pin),
'skip' (hard-crash decks, the other channel still gates), 'exclusion' (proven
upstream bug poisons scoped comparisons, everything else compared).

causes.fpc-delphi-ulp: Delphi(EPRI r4133)-vs-FPC(dss_capi 0.14.5/port) last-ulp libm differences amplified through the solve; the port matches the pinned FPC 0.14.5 oracle EXACTLY (the capi_v0145 channel is bit-clean) while r4133's Delphi build settles a near-identical state a few ulp away. Same class as the proven dSpeed cancellation floor (CLAUDE.md); a floor of the cross-engine build, not a port bug.
causes.iteration-count-delta: Solve/control fixpoint iteration-count deltas vs r4133: Delphi-vs-FPC last-ulp rounding shifts convergence-check outcomes and the reworked controls iterate differently (AutoTrans+RegControl reg-tap, GenDispatcher dispatch). The port matches the pinned FPC oracle's EXACT count on capi_v0145; on r4133 the state is near-identical in a different iteration count.
causes.injection-fpc-delphi-ulp: Injection RHS entries a small factor above the calibrated faer-vs-KLU floor on IndMach-bearing asymmetric decks: Delphi-vs-FPC transcendental last-ulp amplified by the machine model (same class as the dSpeed cancellation floor). Injection assembly + machine model byte-identical across the EPRI delta.
causes.storage-display-precision: EPRI r4133's Delphi renders StorageController-dispatched Storage properties (.kw / %stored / kwhstored) to ~6 significant figures where the port/pinned-oracle return full f64 — a Delphi-vs-FPC Format/Str last-digit RENDERING difference, not an op-point move (expected == actual rounded to 6 sf). The port matches the pinned FPC oracle. Ledgered as exact-pair property/probe entries (discrete state, never an envelope).
causes.pvsystem-display-precision: EPRI r4133's Delphi renders the PVSystem kvar/kva property to ~6 significant figures where the port/pinned-oracle return full f64 — the same Delphi-vs-FPC Format/Str rendering difference as storage-display-precision, exact-pair only.
causes.property-format-brackets: dss_capi's rewritten property system renders array-valued PropertyValue with brackets ('[ 1900 1500 2300]') where EPRI returns plain space-separated ('1900 1500 2300') — a property-rendering difference (dss_capi docs/known_differences.md). Exact-pair only.
causes.eventlog-trailing-space: EPRI r4133 writes a trailing space after relay/control event-log action text ('...LOCKED OUT '); the port (matching dss_capi) trims it. A whitespace rendering artifact on the diffing line only.
causes.harmonics-ieee519-r4133: The documented r4088->r4133 harmonics-mode voltage move on the IEEE_519 filter deck (WP-U0.2; docs/upgrade/sweeps): node V ~4.3e-4 at pcc with the assembled Y bit-identical. Source-confirmed byte-identical harmonics path r4088=r4133 => a build-to-build Delphi last-ulp drift amplified by the near-resonance of the 519 filter (ill-conditioned harmonics fixpoint), NOT a portable behavior change. The port matches the pinned FPC oracle and its own physically-correct harmonics solution.
causes.autotrans-regcontrol-tap: AutoTrans + RegControl reg-tap resolves on a different discrete step FPC(port) vs Delphi(EPRI r4133): a last-ulp voltage nudges the tap decision across a boundary, moving the atf node V. The port matches the pinned FPC oracle; the engine-to-engine sweep shows the same 'regcontrols differ: [rat]', so it is FPC-vs-Delphi, not a port bug.
causes.makeposseq-fpc-delphi: MakePosSequence positive-sequence reduction last-digit drift FPC(port) vs Delphi(EPRI r4133): the reduction averages/collapses the model, amplifying transcendental last-ulp so node V drifts above the tight makeposseq tier. The port matches the pinned FPC oracle; the reduction path is byte-identical r4088=r4133.
causes.reduce-fpc-delphi: Circuit-reduction produces a different reduced network FPC(port) vs Delphi(EPRI r4133): keep/merge/switch handling collapses branches differently, so a reduced Line YPrim can differ structurally and node V drifts. The port matches the pinned FPC oracle's reduced network EXACTLY (mandatory gate green incl. YPrim).
causes.ckt24-regcontrol-conditioning: ckt24 substation RegControl/LDC tap-current at the SubXFMR ultra-switch (1e-8 ohm stitch, Y~1e8 S): the near-cancellation floors at rel ~1.2e-7, and Delphi-vs-FPC last-ulp nudges the substation node V ~1.2x over the faer-vs-KLU-calibrated pinned tol. Documented conditioning floor (STATUS CF-D 'SubXFMR ultra-switch'); the port matches the pinned FPC oracle.
causes.vsource-nearzero-power: Vsource unenergized-conductor power near-zero common mode: EPRI r4133 reports exactly (0,0) on the floating conductor where the port reports ~1e-4 VA (rel ~1e-7 on a 1 kV source) — the near-ideal-source/floating floor class. The port matches the pinned FPC oracle.
causes.monitor-seq-magnitude-drift: Sequence-magnitude monitor channel (V2, mode=32 seq-voltage) drifts above the 1e-6 monitor-channel abs floor: the symmetrical-component transform (Fortescue A-matrix over complex node voltages) amplifies Delphi-vs-FPC transcendental last-ulp. The port matches the pinned FPC oracle; Meters/Monitor.pas byte-identical r4088=r4133.
causes.gic-pct-r2-ignored: GICTransformer `%R`-specified winding 2: both oracle revisions compute G2 := 100.0 / (FZBase2 * FPctR1) -- the G1 line above copied with the base renamed and the percentage not (pinned dss_capi 0.14.5 src/PDElements/GICTransformer.pas:441; EPRI r4133 Version8/Source/PDElements/GICTransformer.pas:495 is the same line) -- so a user's %R2 is stored and read back but never reaches the admittance. It is a slip, not a convention: the same procedure's else arm restores FPctR2 from G2 (:446 / r4133 :498), and the forward and reverse maps are inverses of each other only when the forward one reads FPctR2. Per the 2026-08-02 policy (CLAUDE.md: upstream bugs are never reproduced) GOLDEN_REBASE_PLAN.md G2.5 fixed it in both lanes. These two decks are type=Auto, where the BusX side effect (:251) puts the G1 and G2 blocks in series on the H->X->neutral path, so the element admittance, the assembled Y, every node voltage and every element current move against BOTH oracles (measured 2026-08-06: node V 4.502e-4 V on gictransformer_gic against an allowed 1.001e-6, 1.021e-4 against 1.074e-6 on gic_midi; the tg3/tg5 YPrim block by 4/3). Correct value pinned by dss_core::exec::tests::compat_quirks::gic_transformer_pct_r2_drives_winding_two (crates/dss-core/src/exec/tests/compat_quirks.rs), which measures the %R path against the R1=/R2= ohms path -- the same procedure's else arm, which neither revision ever got wrong and which these very decks also exercise (tg2/tg3, R1=0.2 R2=0.1). Report side: tests/golden/reports/export_gicmvars value columns masked and pinned by golden_reports::export_gicmvars_matches_the_equivalent_ohms_spec; props side: the gictransformer_auto scenario's R2 excluded in props_roundtrip::LANE_SKIP_SCENARIO_PROPS. Blast-radius note (2026-08-07 settle): the divergence class is ANY %R-specified GICTransformer, not just decks that set both percentages -- a deck writing only %R1= now gives winding 2 the %R2 creation default 0.2 (GICTransformer.pas:409-410, r4133 :458-459) instead of repeating %R1. No corpus deck has that shape (the two decks above are the only %R decks and both set both), so only they are ledgered.
causes.makeposseq-cuf-discarded: Capacitor MakePosSequence CMatrix arm: the positive-sequence capacitance Cs - Cm is computed and then lost. dss_capi 0.14.5 aims the SCALAR setter at the ARRAY property Cuf -- SetDouble(ord(TProp.Cuf), (Cs - Cm), []) at src/PDElements/Capacitor.pas:814, whose SetObjDouble tail (src/General/DSSObjectHelper.pas:2812-2834) enumerates only the three scalar double types and has no else -- so the value is dropped with no error while the success path (:3050-3054) still marks the property sequence and runs the Cuf side effect SpecType := 2 (:383-386); the bank then computes from whatever FC held (here the kvar=1200 kv=12.47 creation default, 20.4699706679377 uF) and the user's cmatrix is switched out of MakeYprimWork for good (:926-978). EPRI r4133 predates the typed setters and formats the same value into a command string (Version8/Source/PDElements/Capacitor.pas:829, :834-835), so it DOES apply it through InterpretDblArray (Version8/Source/Common/Utilities.pas:788-791, 'Fills array with zeros if we run out of numbers') -- but Cmatrix is already in farads there (:255) while the cuf side effect multiplies the parsed array by 1.0e-6 again (:411), landing 4e-12 F where 4e-6 F was meant. Neither revision produces the intended bank, and what was intended is unambiguous because r4133 spells the array write out, so GOLDEN_REBASE_PLAN.md G2.5 performs it in both lanes in the property's own uF units. Capacitor.cap_cmat then becomes 4 uF where the oracle keeps 20.47 uF, which moves that element's YPrim, the assembled Y, the node voltages (measured 2026-08-06: 1.158e-1 V against an allowed 3.339e-6) and every element current. Correct value pinned by dss_core::elements::pd::capacitor::tests::make_pos_sequence_cmatrix_applies_the_positive_sequence_cuf (crates/dss-core/src/elements/pd/capacitor/tests.rs), which asserts the reduced bank is indistinguishable from one declared phases=1 cuf=4, and by ...::make_pos_sequence_cmatrix for the emitted action.
causes.mmf-text-accept-set: LoadShape memory-mapped plain-text reader: both oracle revisions filter each comma-delimited column through an accept-set of bytes in [46,58) -- '.' (46), '/' (47) and the digits (48-57) -- pinned dss_capi 0.14.5 src/General/LoadShape.pas:1374 and EPRI r4133 Version8/Source/Common/Utilities.pas:834, the same line. That deletes the sign (45), '+' (43), the exponent letter e/E (101/69) and whitespace while keeping '/' inside the token, so -0.5 reads as 0.5 and 1.5e-3 as 1.53. It is a slip in the mapped reader, not a second file format: TLoadShapeObj owns a SECOND reader for the same file -- ReadCSVFile's non-mapped branch (:1044), which hands each row to the aux parser -- and MemoryMapping=Yes selects how a shape is stored, not what its bytes mean, so the two must agree on identical input. GOLDEN_REBASE_PLAN.md G2.5 made both take the column verbatim through that same parser, in both lanes. shape_mmf.dss exists TO OBSERVE the quirk (its mmpq8.csv P column is written in exponent notation on purpose), so ls_pq now reads {0.15, 0.20, ...} instead of {1.51, 2.01, ...} and the deck moves wholesale against the pinned oracle (measured 2026-08-06: node V 1.641e1 V against an allowed 8.179e-6; Load.ld_pq's YPrim, the assembled Y, the injection RHS, every element channel and all four monitors follow). Correct values pinned by dss_core::elements::general::load_shape::tests::mmf_text_reader_agrees_with_its_non_mapped_twin and ...::mmf_plaintext_reader_keeps_sign_and_exponent (crates/dss-core/src/elements/general/load_shape/tests.rs). The deck's UNRELATED coverage -- the sngfile=/dblfile= MMF readers, the raw mult=(sngfile=) directive form, the pqcsvfile= two-column reader, the array-property round-trip and the Set/Get totaltime surface -- moved to the sibling deck modes:inputformat/shape_mmf_io/shape_mmf_io.dss, which gates clean on the same channel; that exactly one deck can see the change is measured in bytes by ...::mmf_accept_set_fix_is_gated_by_exactly_one_deck.
causes.epri-303-crash: EPRI r4133 raises a #303/#58614 access violation on this deck (binary/MMF GrowthShape, line/cable spacing, or the dss-ext CapControl Type=Follow ControlSignal feature) where the port and the pinned 0.14.5 oracle solve it correctly; the r4133 channel cannot compare it. dss-extensions-era known regression; no port action. The capi_v0145 channel still gates the deck fully.
causes.ncim-oppoint: NCIM (Newton-Current-Injection) is a 0.15.x/r4133 solver the pinned dss_capi 0.14.5 lacks entirely (Set algorithm=NCIM ignored, Export deltaf #24713), so only the r4133 channel gates an NCIM deck — r4133 is the oracle-of-record for NCIM (the capi015 0.15.0b4 probe venv is retired). RESOLVED by the oracle-of-record flip capi015→r4133 (own r4133 epri-worker probes, r4133 = 'Version 11.0.0.1 (64-bit build)', 2026-07-20): the 4 NCIM decks (modes ncim_pq/ncim_pv_pq/ncim_midi + solvable_now Xmission_System_Kundur2Area) are LIVE-gated on r4133 with NO ledger entry — the whole-model compare (node V, system Y, the Vsource swing current/power/loss, the NCIM generators, and the warm-resolve iteration count) is within the tier floor on every case. Converged node V is DIGIT-IDENTICAL r4133-vs-port (~1e-12 faer-vs-KLU); the swing-source reported current now MATCHES r4133 to the floor after dropping the capi015 0.15.0b4 (e936d210) one-conductor off-by-one in VSource — r4133 VSource.pas l.1123/1158 fills GetCurrents(@(ElmCurrents[1])) (offset write → unshifted read); the port aligned in exec/view.rs::ncim_swing_source_currents (the TODO(compat) was removed). Warm-resolve iterations match r4133 exactly (2/2/2 on the modes decks, 1 on Kundur2Area). This cause is now documentary (referenced by no entry); see docs/upgrade/DIVERGENCES.md and exec/tests/ncim.rs.
causes.gfm-pctstored-rounding: Grid-forming (GFM) storage decks: the r4133 physics matches the port (the port adopted the r4133 Isc1 default, DIVERGENCES.md #b5) EXCEPT the Storage.%stored property getter STRING, which r4133's Delphi rounds to ~4-6 decimals (e.g. 92.4321) where the port/pinned-oracle return full f64 (92.4320641163609) — a getter rendering difference, exact-pair only. On the capi_v0145 channel the deck cannot gate: 0.14.5's different Isc1 default makes the assembled system-Y differ wholesale (x1000), a deliberate model default the port follows r4133 on.
causes.regcontrol-idle: RegControl `idle` is a 0.15.x/r4133 feature the pinned dss_capi 0.14.5 rejects (#110 Unknown parameter 'idle'), so only the r4133 channel gates the idle-regulator deck. BUG WP regcontrol_idle (2026-07-19): the port adopted r4133's no-load-zone AND semantics (idle when the through-power is inside the BOUNDED [RevPowerThreshold, FwdPowerThreshold] band; r4133 RegControl.pas:1218). dss_capi 0.15.x wrote it as an `or` (8a898cba, still OR at the 0.15.x tip) — a tautology under the default symmetric band that made an idling reg never tap; the port previously reproduced it (MV.1 8.8% low). After adoption the idle tap/voltage match r4133 exactly (tapnum 15, tap 1.09375, MV.1=7650.08 V; probe D: widening fwdThreshold to bracket the load makes r4133 idle to the old 7030.24 V, proving the bounded-AND mechanism). The only residual is a getter-convention difference on revThreshold/fwdThreshold: r4133's getter returns the InitPropertyValues display strings (revThreshold '100' = band half-width, RegControl.pas:1448; fwdThreshold unset '') decoupled from the signed internal, while the port reports the signed effective thresholds in kW (rev -100, fwd +100). Definitional, not physics — exact-pair.
causes.linespacing-normamps: Line built from LineSpacing+wiredata: dss_capi 0.14.5 reports Line.lsp.normamps=730/emergamps=1095 (the FIRST wire's NormAmps rating, ACSR_556) where the port and the newer engines (0.15.x/r4133) report 230/345 — the MINIMUM NormAmps over the phase conductors (min{556->730, 4-0->340, 1-0->230}=230; r4133 V8 LineGeometry.pas:1237-1239, WP-U1.2 D3). The port follows the corrected 0.15.x min-over-phase derivation, so on capi_v0145 it intentionally diverges from 0.14.5 (settled empirically 2026-07-18: port=230/345, oracle 0.14.5=730/1095 — the port value matches the r4133 source and is CORRECT). r4133 additionally #303-crashes this deck (skip). Exact-pair property entry on capi_v0145.
causes.generator-makeposseq-foreign-slots: dss_capi 0.14.5's TGeneratorObj.MakePosSequence decides "the user set kVA=/MVA=" from the raw property-sequence slots [26]/[27] (Generator.pas:2804-2806), but its enum reorder moved Xdp/Xdpp into 26/27 while kVA/MVA sit at 23/24, so both rating guards read foreign cells: a 3-phase generator declared with kVA=/MVA= keeps its full rating after makeposseq instead of having it divided by the phase count. EPRI r4133 writes the same two literals (Version8/Source/PCElements/generator.pas:3060-3062) but there they are CORRECT — kVA is registered at 26 and MVA at 27 (:459-460), Xdp/Xdpp at 29/30 (:463/:465) — so the defect is a dss_capi regression, not upstream behaviour. Per the 2026-08-02 policy the port follows r4133 in both lanes and divides the rating; the pinned 0.14.5 oracle keeps the undivided value. Exact-pair (a discrete value jump, not display precision).
causes.line-merge-length-units-reset: TLineObj.MergeWith's matrix-model series branch and the length units. EPRI r4133 saves the units before the merge (Version8/Source/PDElements/Line.pas:1627 LenUnitsSaved := LengthUnits) and re-applies them with a SEPARATE Edit that runs AFTER the Rmatrix/Xmatrix (:1778-1779) and Cmatrix (:1791-1792) Edits -- Format(' Length=%-g  Units=%s', [TotalLen, LineUnitsStr(LenUnitsSaved)]) at :1794-1796 -- precisely because the 12..14 property side effect calls ResetLengthUnits (:691-693). Its MakePosSequence uses the same construction for the same reason (:1595-1596, 'Repeat the Length Units to compensate for unexpected reset'). The pinned dss_capi 0.14.5 inverted the two: src/PDElements/Line.pas:1806-1807 writes Len and LengthUnits as FIELDS and :1815-1817 then runs PropertySideEffects(rmatrix/xmatrix/cmatrix), whose ResetLengthUnits (:2080-2085) wipes LengthUnits back to UNITS_NONE one statement later, so every matrix-model series merge on 0.14.5 reports 'none'. The port had copied that order; r4133 is the behavioral authority and its bugs are never reproduced (CLAUDE.md 2026-08-02), so R4133_PROPS_PLAN RP3.5 fixed it in BOTH lanes and the three merged lines of this deck now render their saved 'kft'. Probed live 2026-08-28 on the r4133 DLL (Version 11.0.0.1, tools/opendss/bin/r4133): 'kft' on all three merged lines here, and deck-dependent elsewhere ('mi'/'cm' on two purpose-built micro-decks, 'none' on a switch), so the getter is live state (LineUnitsStr(LengthUnits), :1404) and not an echo. NOTHING ELSE MOVES: ConvertLineUnits returns 1.0 whenever either side is UNITS_NONE (Shared/LineUnits.pas:110-115), so FUnitsConvert is 1.0 on both engines either way and the merged line's YPrim, the assembled Y, the node voltages, currents, powers, losses, the node count (88) and the iteration count (5) are identical -- 'units' is the only divergent cell on the whole case, measured on all three engines. Correct value pinned by dss_core::exec::tests::reduce::merged_matrix_line_keeps_the_surviving_lines_length_units, which reads two micro-decks whose surviving lines carry DIFFERENT saved units (so the pin cannot pass against a hardwired getter) plus an un-merged control and a post-merge rmatrix= reset.
causes.line-switch-kills-linecode: TLineObj.PropertySideEffects arm 15 (switch=) and the LineCode flag. EPRI r4133 keeps TWO independent pieces of state: FLineCodeSpecified (Boolean) and CondCode (the lowercased code name), both set by FetchLineCode (Version8/Source/PDElements/Line.pas:385-387, :413). The flag is cleared by the impedance side effects -- arms 6..11, 26..27 open with FLineCodeSpecified := FALSE (:685) and so do arms 12..14 (:691) -- but arm 15, the switch= arm, does NOT touch it: :694-700 assigns SymComponentsChanged, YprimInvalid, GeometrySpecified := FALSE, SpacingSpecified := False, r1/x1/r0/x0 := 1.0, c1 := 1.1e-9, c0 := 1.0e-9, len := 0.001 and calls ResetLengthUnits, and contains no FLineCodeSpecified statement. The omission is written arm by arm, one line above and one line below the two arms that do clear it, not forgotten at the end of a block. The flag is read live by the property getter (3: If FLineCodeSpecified Then Result := CondCode else Result := '', :1357) -- it is NOT an echo of PropertyValue[], so this pair carries no PROPS_ECHO_R4133 row -- and by the units= arm, which picks ConvertLineUnits(FLineCodeUnits, NewLengthUnits) when the flag is TRUE and FUnitsConvert * ConvertLineUnits(LengthUnits, NewLengthUnits) when it is FALSE (:626-627). The pinned dss_capi 0.14.5 ADDED a kill to that arm and flagged it in its own source: KillLineCodeSpecified(); //TODO: check if this missing is relevant bug (.inputs/dss_capi/src/PDElements/Line.pas:677). The port had copied 0.14.5 (elements/pd/line/accessors.rs, SWITCH arm). r4133 is the behavioral authority and upstream bugs are never reproduced (CLAUDE.md 2026-08-02), so R4133_PROPS_PLAN RP3.6 deleted that one call in BOTH lanes; the six other kill_line_code_specified call sites each match an r4133 counterpart and are untouched. No impedance moves on this corpus: every one of the five cells declares units=m on the LineCode and units=m on the Line, so the TRUE branch computes ConvertLineUnits(m, m) = 1.0 and the FALSE branch computes 1.0 * ConvertLineUnits(none, m) = 1.0 (Shared/LineUnits.pas -- either operand UNITS_NONE yields 1.0). Measured live 2026-08-29 on all three engines: r1 = '1' on r4133, on the 0.14.5 oracle and in the port, node voltages agreeing to 1.1e-10 relative and the r4133-vs-port current spread (9.7e-08) SMALLER than the capi-vs-port spread (1.9e-07) on the same deck, i.e. the residual is the documented faer-vs-KLU near-cancellation floor on an ideal switch, not a flag effect. The flag's real consequence is pinned on a purpose-built discriminating deck (a code in kft, the line in m, where the two branches differ by 304.8) by exec::tests::line_fetch::switch_yes_keeps_the_linecode_and_its_units_conversion, in both lanes and without an oracle. The r4133 channel needs no entry: after the RP4.1 unmask these five cells compare and MATCH, which is the point of the sub-step.

entries.source: GOLDEN_REBASE G2.5 measurement 2026-08-06 (DSS_GATE_ONLY, pinned dss-python 0.15.7): applying Cs - Cm = 4 uF to Capacitor.cap_cmat moves step-0 node V 1.158e-1 V (allowed 3.339e-6), that element's YPrim, the assembled Y and its fingerprint. Scoped to those: the injection RHS was measured to stay inside the tier floor and is deliberately NOT excluded, and neither are the other eight elements' YPrims, the discrete state or the four manifest probes. The `voltages` and `element` scopes are DECK-WIDE and were re-measured artifact-by-artifact at the G2.5 audit settle (2026-08-07, per-artifact verdict probe): ALL 14 elements and ALL nodes exceed their tier floor here, so the blanket is exactly the measured set.

GOLDEN_REBASE G2.5 measurement 2026-08-06 (DSS_GATE_ONLY, pinned dss-python 0.15.7): honouring %R2=0.15 on the type=Auto tg3 moves its YPrim G2 block by 4/3, the assembled Y, its fingerprint and step-0 node V by 4.502e-4 V (allowed 1.001e-6). Scoped to those: the injection RHS was measured to stay inside the tier floor (the GICLine/GICsource drives do not depend on the solution) and is deliberately NOT excluded; neither are the GICLine/Reactor YPrims or the discrete state. The `voltages` and `element` scopes are DECK-WIDE and were re-measured artifact-by-artifact at the G2.5 audit settle (2026-08-07, per-artifact verdict probe): ALL 9 elements and ALL nodes exceed their tier floor here, so the blanket is exactly the measured set.

GOLDEN_REBASE G2.5 measurement 2026-08-06 (epri-worker, EPRI r4133): the same divergence on the r4133 channel -- Version8/Source/PDElements/GICTransformer.pas:495 carries the identical FPctR1 line, so both gating oracles agree with each other and differ from the corrected engine. Same scopes, same measurement; the 2026-08-07 per-artifact re-measurement returned the identical verdict on this channel (all 9 elements and all nodes above floor).

GOLDEN_REBASE G2.5 measurement 2026-08-06 (DSS_GATE_ONLY, pinned dss-python 0.15.7): the same fix on tg5 of the 6-substation ring -- its YPrim G2 block, the assembled Y, its fingerprint and step-0 node V (B1.1 by 1.021e-4 V against an allowed 1.074e-6; the worst node is B5X by 5.232e-1 V against 2.966e-6). The injection RHS was measured clean here too and is not excluded, nor are the two GICsource splice probes (Line.seg45/seg56 bus2). The `voltages` and `element` scopes are DECK-WIDE, and the artifact-by-artifact re-measurement at the G2.5 audit settle (2026-08-07, per-artifact verdict probe) shows this deck is the one where the blanket is WIDER than the above-floor set: 12 of 18 elements and 26 of 33 nodes exceed. The six sub-floor elements (GICLine.gl12/gl23/gl34, GICTransformer.tg3, Reactor.gg3, Reactor.g2) and the seven sub-floor nodes (B3.1-3, B3.4, B3X.1-3) are NOT unaffected -- every one of them moves, they merely land under the floor (B3.1 by 9.291e-7 against a 3.139e-6 floor, ~30% of it; b2, which feeds Reactor.g2, moves 4.760e-6 against 1.020e-6 and IS above it). The blanket is kept deliberately: an `exclusion` has no per-scope staleness accounting, so a 12-name allowlist would be twelve claims that each still diverges with nothing to catch the first one that stops -- more silent rot than it removes -- whereas 'this deck's solved model is not compared on this channel' is one statement the voltages-scope liveness check does police. Narrow it only with a fresh measurement.

GOLDEN_REBASE G2.5 measurement 2026-08-06 (epri-worker, EPRI r4133): the same divergence on the r4133 channel, same scopes; the 2026-08-07 per-artifact re-measurement returned the identical verdict on this channel (12 of 18 elements, 26 of 33 nodes above floor -- see the capi twin's source for why the scopes stay deck-wide).

R4133-alignment pass 2026-08-02 (issue 27): the compat kernel GENERATOR_POSSEQ_RATING_GUARDS_READ_XDP_SLOTS was dismantled, so BOTH lanes read the kVA/MVA slots the guards are named after (r4133 generator.pas:3060-3062 + :459-460). The pinned 0.14.5 oracle keeps the undivided ratings (g_kva 250 / 0.25, g_mva 300 / 0.3) where the port divides by the 3 phases of the FIRST makeposseq (83.3333333333333 / 0.0833333333333333, 100 / 0.1); the second makeposseq is a no-op because the machine is 1-phase by then. Five scopes: the deck probes generator.g_kva.kva, and the MODES family forces compare_all_properties on the capi channel, which reads all four cells again through the whole-element dump. kVA and MVA are ONE field (PropertyOffset aims both at GenVars.kVArating), which is why each generator lists both readouts. The rating reaches no power-flow quantity — it scales Xdp/Xdpp and the dynamics inertia only — so nothing else on the deck moves. Values measured live 2026-08-02 against the pinned dss-python 0.15.7 / dss_capi 0.14.5 and the built engine. Replacement pins: elements::pc::generator::tests::makeposseq_generator_{kva,mva}_guard_reads_its_own_slot and ...::makeposseq_generator_xdp_does_not_touch_the_kva_rating.
